name: Crucible Tender

Compact industrial brass spider robot chassis with exactly four splayed articulated walking legs, each foot clearly distinct, and TWO separate upper tool arms. One central round soot-stained lens in body, aged brass joints and heat-darkened plates. No extra legs. Head and chassis square to viewer in neutral stance, tool arms spread enough to identify tools. Warm painterly detailed metal, clear bold silhouette. Full four feet, torch tip and scoop within square transparent canvas with generous margins. No floor, shadows, sparks, arc beam cloud, smoke, text or other objects. Full welding effect animated separately.
